findings.summary: Corrected local acceptance criterion UNMET in both candidate full attempts
Corrected criterion's 'no additional failures' clause is not robust to measured base flake rate, and the paired base/candidate attribution was applied to only 2 of 3 additional failures
No test asserts doctor --help lists the new 'exec profiles' check; AC3's help clause is unguarded (production bytes do contain the update)
AC5 census numbers 60/0/4 are logged, not asserted; the guard works through the production-edge allowlist
Declared residual: context-free archives and scheduling have no established total startup bound, so the 30s service health wait can still expire

steps: R1 (required): paired pristine/candidate arms, N>=100 each, outside the sandbox, for TestExecProbeNet6ForeignDialIsRetriedNotRefused. Fails in both arms => base flake, excluded; candidate-arm-only => real regression and a source blocker.

R2 (controller-owned, explicit): amend the corrected criterion to 'no additional failure that is not reproduced at base', preserving the original correction document and the pinned plan hash for audit.
R3: re-measure the amended local full-Go criterion once on the candidate head, keeping the requirement that all Linux CI checks stay green.
R4 (optional, not a blocker): assert doctor --help lists 'exec profiles'; pin AC5 census numbers as assertions.
R5: merge-head Linux CI remains a controller-owned post-evaluation obligation.
